reason: Nobody in my Telegram chats has mentioned this app yet, so I'd maybe try the free 3 fragments, but I won't pay. For an interview I worry more about what I say and my grammar than about single sounds, and this doesn't check that.
objection: I don't believe an app can score my pronunciation accurately enough to trust a number per sound, and pronunciation is not my main problem in an interview.
would_change_my_mind: Several people in the IELTS or job-search Telegram groups saying it really helped them in an actual interview, with screenshots of their scores improving.
